archetype: Pastel & Soft / Organic Minimalist (Google Calendar & Notion inspired)

typography.font_pairing_notes: Use font-sans with Plus Jakarta Sans for titles/toolbar/modal headers and DM Sans for event detail, time labels, badge text.

toolbar.container: flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 p-4 bg-white border border-slate-200/80 rounded-xl shadow-sm mb-4
toolbar.today_btn: px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-200 transition-colors active:scale-95
toolbar.nav_btns: p-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:text-slate-900 transition-colors
toolbar.title: text-lg md:text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 font-heading tracking-tight
toolbar.stats_badge: px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 rounded-full border border-slate-200/60
toolbar.view_switcher: inline-flex p-1 bg-slate-100 rounded-lg border border-slate-200/60 gap-1
toolbar.view_btn_active: px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold bg-white text-slate-900 rounded-md shadow-sm transition-all
toolbar.view_btn_inactive: px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 rounded-md transition-all
toolbar.new_cita_btn: inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-lg font-medium text-sm shadow-sm hover:shadow transition-all active:scale-95

time_grid_header.wrapper: grid border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/50 text-slate-600 font-medium text-xs rounded-t-xl
time_grid_header.day_num_active: inline-flex items-center justify-center w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-blue-600 text-white font-bold text-sm shadow-sm mt-0.5
time_grid_header.day_num: inline-flex items-center justify-center w-7 h-7 rounded-full text-slate-800 font-bold text-sm mt-0.5 hover:bg-slate-200/60

time_grid.container: bg-white border border-slate-200/80 rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden
time_grid.hour_gutter: w-16 text-right pr-3 text-xs text-slate-400 font-medium select-none border-r border-slate-200/60
time_grid.out_of_hours: bg-slate-50/70 relative backdrop-blur-[1px] (replacing harsh diagonal stripes with clean soft slate fill + subtle boundary line)

now_indicator.line: absolute left-0 right-0 border-t-2 border-rose-500 z-20 pointer-events-none
now_indicator.dot: absolute -left-1.5 -top-1.5 w-3 h-3 bg-rose-500 rounded-full shadow-sm ring-2 ring-white

event_card.container: absolute inset-x-1 rounded-lg p-2 shadow-xs border transition-all hover:shadow-md hover:z-30 cursor-pointer overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-between group
event_card.title: font-semibold text-xs leading-snug truncate font-heading
event_card.badge: inline-block px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold rounded-md border

month_grid.container: grid grid-cols-7 border-t border-l border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm bg-slate-200/60 gap-[1px]
month_grid.cell: bg-white min-h-[110px] p-1.5 flex flex-col justify-between hover:bg-slate-50/80 transition-colors
month_grid.event_chip: px-2 py-0.5 text-xs rounded-md truncate font-medium border border-transparent shadow-2xs mb-1 hover:brightness-95 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-between gap-1
month_grid.more_badge: text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-500 hover:text-blue-600 px-1 py-0.5 cursor-pointer

legend.container: flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 p-3 bg-white border border-slate-200/80 rounded-xl shadow-sm mt-4 text-xs text-slate-600

upcoming_today_panel.container: w-72 bg-white border border-slate-200/80 rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm flex flex-col gap-3
upcoming_today_panel.header: text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center justify-between font-heading
upcoming_today_panel.item: p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-100 hover:border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/50 hover:bg-white transition-all shadow-2xs cursor-pointer

instructions_to_main_agent: Maintain all existing data-testid attributes for testing compatibility (e.g. data-testid='agenda-calendar').
Replace out-of-hours diagonal striping in TimeGrid with clean soft tint `bg-slate-50/70` and clean hairline borders.
Implement Google Calendar / Notion soft color aesthetic using rounded surfaces, subtle inner borders, and high contrast typography.
Use standard interactive states with explicit hover and focus colors.
Ensure responsiveness on mobile viewports for Day/Week/Month switcher.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_ai_slop: Avoid generic centered layouts or muddy gradients.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testids: All interactive buttons and calendar containers MUST retain data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Generous inner padding for touch targets and card legibility.
